scientific_integrity: The homotopy claims follow from a complete finite acyclic discrete-Morse certificate at scale three, an independent scale-four structural join proof, and an explicit relative collapse at scale two; finite checks concern precisely the stated finite object.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification of the fourteen-vertex Fano incidence graph only; not a statement about higher-order projective planes or arbitrary cubic girth-six graphs. Unindexed equivalent literature is a residual risk.
